source_snapshot.procedure: Set Package C-State limits C0/C1, C2 and C6 one at a time in BIOS, save/reset, boot OS and inspect PTAT/cpupower/turbostat; repeat for every limit.
source_snapshot.criteria: C0/C1: PC2=0 and PC6=0; C2: PC2 nonzero and PC6=0; C6: PC2 and PC6 nonzero.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 30/60 minutes; unique code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic OS sample with plaintext sshpass, disabled host verification, malformed quoting, cpu0-only state names and truncated one-sample turbostat; omits the BIOS option matrix.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; retains operator-owned BIOS changes and complete per-option package-residency evidence/recovery.

old_problem: Supported option labels, package topology, tool/field mapping, identical idle observation protocol, zero/nonzero tolerance and final restored BIOS setting are unspecified. DeepSeek confuses core cpuidle availability with package residency, omits all three BIOS states and weakens credential/evidence safety.
disposition_reason: The source already defines the three functional expectations; missing exact labels, observation window and PC2/PC6 mapping are Project Configuration. ED-11 rejects random/all BIOS modification, so only the three named supported settings may be changed by an authorized operator. Package-level counters must be collected consistently for every socket and final configuration restored; no threshold is invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2043, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2044 / Wistron-BIOS-00493-V002 / d7e8cf23211b60d5 was directly read from XLSX.
Package residency counters are not proven by cpu0 cpuidle state names; PC2/PC6 must be mapped to the approved tool fields for every CPU package.
Each C0/C1, C2 and C6 limit uses the same approved idle preparation, observation duration and cadence so zero/nonzero comparisons are meaningful.
Only source-enumerated, platform-supported settings are exercised; save/reset and restoration remain human-authorized with failed-boot recovery.
No plaintext credential, disabled host-key checking, tail truncation, one-sample shortcut or log clearing is accepted.
No BIOS entry/write/save/reset, OS login, PTAT/cpupower/turbostat collection or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Three-limit Package C-state residency and restoration matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify on every CPU package that the supported C0/C1, C2 and C6 Package C-State limits produce the source-defined PC2/PC6 residency pattern under one controlled idle protocol, then restore the approved final BIOS setting.
required_package: Exact row-2043 variant plus SUT/BIOS/BMC/CPU model, stepping and socket/package topology
Approved BIOS recipe with exact supported C0/C1, C2 and C6 labels, initial/final setting and console path
Approved PTAT/cpupower/turbostat versions and authoritative per-package PC2/PC6 field mapping
Approved idle preparation, observation duration/cadence and zero/nonzero measurement tolerance
Maintenance/reset authorization, secure OS access and failed-boot BIOS recovery
test_case.test_command: HYBRID OPERATOR-GATED; preserve initial BIOS screen/export and logs. For each approved limit in order C0/C1, C2, C6, an authorized operator selects only that exact BIOS option, records visual evidence, saves/resets once and proves OS Ready. Under identical approved idle conditions, collect complete untruncated package-residency output from the approved tool for the full interval and map PC2/PC6 for every package. Compare to the source matrix. After the last observation, restore and visually verify the approved final BIOS setting with one authorized reset. Do not clear logs, alter OS power policy, use insecure SSH or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: For every package and approved observation window: C0/C1 has PC2 and PC6 at the approved zero tolerance; C2 has PC2 nonzero and PC6 zero; C6 has both PC2 and PC6 nonzero. Every transition boots to OS Ready without new faults and the final BIOS setting equals the approved recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all three supported limits, every package, authoritative field mapping, identical observation conditions, source-defined residency pattern and verified restoration. FAIL on unsupported/wrong setting, failed boot, missing package/counter, pattern mismatch, new power/thermal/kernel fault or failed restoration. Missing mapping/window/tolerance/approval is NOT READY; no invented threshold or partial PASS.
safety_gate: Only the three approved Package C-State options may be changed; no all/random BIOS modification.
Human authorization and console recovery are required before each save/reset; preserve before/after visual evidence.
Stop on unsupported option, failed boot, missing counter, topology change or power/thermal/kernel anomaly.
No log clearing, plaintext credentials, OS power-policy write or automatic BIOS retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, CPU/package topology and approved BIOS/tool recipe
Initial and per-limit BIOS visual/export evidence plus save/reset/OS-ready timestamps
Complete per-package PTAT/cpupower/turbostat outputs with versions, duration, cadence and exits
C0/C1, C2 and C6 PC2/PC6 matrix against the approved zero/nonzero interpretation
Boot/kernel/power/thermal logs for each transition and missing-counter analysis
Final restored BIOS evidence, no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported option, failed boot, missing counter or anomaly, stop and preserve console, BIOS and OS logs. Use the pre-approved console recovery to restore the recorded initial/final Package C-State value; do not randomize settings or retry automatically. Escalate if restoration or OS Ready cannot be proven.

source_conflict.reason: Exact supported labels, per-package field mapping and one approved observation protocol resolve the source gaps while retaining the complete C0/C1-C2-C6 matrix.

blocked.reason: The hybrid method, verdict and recovery are complete; platform labels, tool map and observation rules are runtime Project Configuration.
